queries.query: SELECT Timestamp, SeverityText, ServiceName, Body FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT Timestamp, SeverityText, ServiceName, Body FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT now64(3) - toIntervalMillisecond(number) AS Timestamp, ['EMERG', 'fatal', 'Critical', 'ERR', 'error', 'WARN', 'warning', 'information', 'NOTICE', 'dbug', 'trace', 'verbose'][number + 1] AS SeverityText, 'line' AS Body FROM numbers(12)
SELECT now64(3) - toIntervalMillisecond(number) AS Timestamp, 'line' AS Body FROM numbers(1200)
